Compose and Stage gate-collector fix under STAGE111-ROLLBACK-RTO-REGRESSION-20261109 after real Stage run 42552683248 (release pantheon-20261108-111, dev bdd2b8e54) passed Stage 1-2 but failed Stage 3 with ROLLBACK_VERIFICATION_FAILED (rollback 135.651s > 120s RTO gate; drain=10.683s, baseline_up=65.070s, owners_healthy=41.221s, readyz_200=6.169s, readback=12.506s). Root causes and fixes without loosening the 120s RTO gate or modifying product images/release declarations: (1) drain (10.683s -> ~0.8s): lifecycle-projector runs python as PID 1 without a SIGTERM handler and waited out the 10s default stop timeout on compose rm -fsv; added stop_signal: SIGINT and stop_grace_period: 2s in Stage and Prod compose; (2) baseline_up (65.070s -> ~16-22s): Docker Compose v2 recreateContainer stops old containers across 4 depends_on waves before starting any replacement container (causing the observed 30-40s gap between Created 02:58:47Z and StartedAt 02:59:28-38Z), where paper-signal-producer lacked stop_signal: SIGINT and blocked on its 30s stop_grace_period (02:58:58Z -> 02:59:28Z), other Python-PID-1 services (runtime-manager, lineage-read, telemetry, agora-interaction-worker) lacked stop_signal: SIGINT, and sh -c uvicorn wrappers waited 10s per wave; added stop_signal: SIGINT to all Python-PID-1 services and bounded stop_grace_period to 2s (5s on paper-fleet-reconciler and paper-signal-producer) in both Stage and Prod compose; (3) owners_healthy (41.221s -> ~16-20s): paper-signal-producer had healthcheck.interval: 30s (delaying Docker starting->healthy transition by 30s after start) and _wait_product_owners ran 24 sequential docker compose ps -q calls (~10.8s of YAML parsing) on every sample; lowered healthcheck.interval to 5s (start_period: 5s on paper workers) across all 17 product owners with healthchecks in Stage and Prod compose (preserving 10s/15s on governance and deployment) and cached known_cids across consecutive samples in _wait_product_owners; (4) readyz_200 (6.169s -> ~0.5-2.0s): lowered default _wait_bff_ready polling interval from 3s to 1s; (5) readback (12.506s -> ~1.5-2.5s): reused last_verified_cids from _wait_product_owners before docker inspect instead of repeating 24 sequential docker compose ps -q calls. Expected total Stage rollback duration: ~35-48s (saving ~90s, well under the unchanged 120s RTO gate).

prod_ops_sudo_env_and_120gb_boot_disk_re.trigger: Protected Prod run 45897091923 (job 140173674161) installed Docker Compose v2 and migrated offline boot-disk state onto replacement e2-standard-8 VM, then failed at two defects: (1) prod_ops.sh compose() called run_priv (sudo without -E) instead of run_priv_env (sudo -E), stripping exported PANTHEON_* release/image variables during restore_active_release and rollback; (2) 50GB boot disk on replacement VM had low free root space while pre-pulling all 25+ release plus rollback baseline images
prod_ops_sudo_env_and_120gb_boot_disk_re.scope: source, script, and local test validation only; no live VM replacement, cloud provisioning, secrets access, or production/staging workflow dispatch
changes: scripts/deploy/prod_ops.sh adds run_priv_env() ('if [[ "${PROD_USE_SUDO:-false}" == "true" || "${FAKE_OSLOGIN_NONROOT:-false}" == "true" ]]; then "$SUDO" -E "$@"; else "$@"; fi') matching deploy/production/bootstrap.sh and updates compose() to use run_priv_env "$DOCKER" compose ... so sudo never strips exported PANTHEON_* release/image variables during restore_active_release or rollback

scripts/deploy/prod_replace_vm.sh adds PROD_MIN_BOOT_DISK_GB="${PROD_MIN_BOOT_DISK_GB:-120}", computes TARGET_BOOT_SIZE_GB as max(int(OLD_BOOT_SIZE_GB), int(PROD_MIN_BOOT_DISK_GB)), bumps PROD_DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_NAME default to pantheon-prod-control-template-e2s8-v3, passes --boot-disk-size="${TARGET_BOOT_SIZE_GB}GB" when creating the instance template, and in template_is_compatible() requires boot disk initializeParams.diskSizeGb >= PROD_MIN_BOOT_DISK_GB whenever initializeParams.diskSizeGb is present in template JSON (preserving minimal mock templates that omit disks), plus passes PROD_BASELINE_READY_TRIES="${PROD_BASELINE_READY_TRIES:-60}" to restore_active_release in both RESTORE_OUT and rollback_to_old_boot_disk, waits up to 15s for Caddy /deployment.json readiness after starting pantheon-caddy, and captures rollback stderr into rollback_error in rollback JSON output if rollback_to_old_boot_disk fails

deploy/production/bootstrap.sh extracts docker_registry_login() helper and retries docker pull up to PROD_IMAGE_PULL_TRIES="${PROD_IMAGE_PULL_TRIES:-3}" (sleeping PROD_IMAGE_PULL_RETRY_DELAY default 3 and re-running docker_registry_login on retry when PROD_REGISTRY_AUTH=true), including sanitized pull error and df -Pm / free_mb in fail IMAGE_PULL_FAILED

docs/deployment/production-control-runbook.md documents run_priv_env in prod_ops.sh, >= 120 GB boot disk on pantheon-prod-control-template-e2s8-v3, and bootstrap image pull retry within the <= 180-line runbook contract

tests/deployment/test_production_release.py adds test_bootstrap_retries_transient_docker_pull_failures_and_reports_disk_diagnostics in BootstrapTests and test_replace_vm_preserves_sudo_compose_env_and_upgrades_50gb_boot_disk_template_to_v3_120gb in ReplaceVmHarness covering prod_ops.sh restore_active_release and rollback under PROD_USE_SUDO=true + FAKE_SUDO_RESET_ENV=true, >= 120GB boot disk template upgrade from 50GB v2 to 120GB v3, rollback_error capture when rollback fails, and bootstrap.sh docker pull retry

runtime_budget.change: unchanged from g80: no new recurring job, emitter, or background daemon; replacement control VM boot disk size minimum increased from 50 GB to 120 GB pd-balanced on pantheon-prod-control-template-e2s8-v3 to hold Docker CE packages and 25+ release plus rollback baseline container images without root filesystem exhaustion
